profile.headline: Software Engineer at NBCUniversal
profile.summary: Anthony Nasser | Full Stack Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered AI-powered real-time translation system for 33 languages that efficiently and concurrently translate specified pages of content.
- Led end-to-end development of Brandboom Pro Wholesale, a React Native mobile application for wholesale inventory and order management
- Overhauled high-traffic customers page in Vue to improve speed and usability and support thousands of client brand agents
- Implemented AI buyer-recommendation system using RESTful Java APIs to support client brands and sales
- Enhanced an image processing AWS Lambda in Node.js that handles 50k+ jobs daily
- Reduced onboarding time for client partners by overhauling internal REST API to accommodate standard external integrations
- Collaborated with an Agile, cross-functional team to redesign core inventory system to ensure high-quality code through peer reviews and adherence to SDLC best practices
- Resolved 175+ full stack bugs and performance issues across a legacy JS, Vue, and PHP B2B e-commerce platform
- Streamlined cloud resource management and reduced deployment time using AWS SAM
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Vue.js · PHP · JavaScript · Objective-C · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Built a mobile travel booking app for remote workers, streamlining international trip planning by consolidating flights, accommodations, and event reservations into a single platform
- Developed an AI-powered itinerary generation system that created personalized trip recommendations based on user questionnaire responses, automating the travel planning process
- Integrated AWS Cognito for user authentication, enabling secure access control for app features and user data
- Set up AWS API Gateway and Lambda to handle backend automation, including email notifications via SES and payment processing through Stripe
- Followed Agile practices including daily standups, sprint planning sessions, and retrospectives to keep development on track
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · React Native

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.locationName: Long Beach, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Independent Developer
positions.description:
- (2023) Led a team of 4 developers to launch Botmo, a mobile app that enables users to seamlessly create and share AI chat bots that are powered by different large language models. Achieved 5,500+ downloads and 55 monthly/annual subscribers.
- (2022) Shipped Synapse AI, an OpenAI API BYOK querying tool deployed ahead of the official ChatGPT App. Reached 1200+ paid downloads.
- (2022) Shipped RabbitHole AI, a Swift/SwiftUI App that lets you drill down into topics using generative AI.
positions.insights: Skills: Product Management · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React Native · Swift

positions.title: Co-Founder and Full Stack Mobile Developer
positions.description:
- Winner of a 2 unique grant programs through pitch competitions
- Planned and iterated on business models, pitch decks, and financial projections to drive strategic decision-making and secure funding for venture.
- Worked with a small development team to ship a mobile application, marketing website, and administration dashboard.
- Owned major features across different applications end-to-end, including a group component that integrated live chat, geolocations, an invite system, and a recommendation engine.
- Designed and implemented a cost-efficient backend with the Firebase suite to enhance resource allocation and data security.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Firebase · Project Management

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.locationName: Long Beach, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Coordinated with clients to execute hundreds of modifications and fixes across four high-traffic websites
- Designed and deployed a more efficient ticketing system that improved development workflow and internal client experience
- Created an automated analytics dashboard to track key metrics and seasonal trends for CSULB websites and apps
- Performed an extensive mobile audit to optimize responsiveness across hundreds of website screens to achieve data-driven goals
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · HTML · PhpMyAdmin · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · jQuery · Digital Marketing · React
